assumptions.statement: The internal services require DNS records that are strictly isolated from the public internet and not visible outside the local environment.
assumptions.quote: These records should not be visible outside the local environment or stack.

assumptions.statement: The organization has the budget and administrative capability to purchase and maintain a dedicated domain name that will remain unused in public DNS.
assumptions.quote: We've bought a domain name that will not be connected to the rest of the public DNS system.

assumptions.statement: The risk of domain expiration and subsequent registration by a third party is considered acceptable because it is a common risk across all domains used by the organization.
assumptions.quote: This risk is however present in all the domains we use.
